rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.sources.configuration against rust:mdbook-dada/src/configuration.rs:SourceConfiguration::load, rust:mdbook-dada/src/configuration.rs:SourceConfiguration::lean_root, rust:mdbook-dada/src/configuration.rs:SourceConfiguration::markdown_root, rust:mdbook-dada/src/configuration.rs:SourceConfiguration::check_context, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:process_configured, rust:mdbook-dada/src/inventory.rs:Inventory::inputs, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:configured_lean_root_is_shared_by_rendering_and_evidence. SourceConfiguration loads book.toml and resolves both source roots through project containment; check_context rejects differing runtime overrides and process_configured uses those roots. Inventory includes book.toml. The test moves Lean sources under formal/model, verifies both renderer and bundle select the changed declaration, rejects an override and keeps Rust selection rooted at the project. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
